title: Near-death experiencers describe living buildings with doors that open like molten metal

tellings.quote: I've got a whole list of maybe 20 so far.

plain: People who nearly died and say they visited another realm describe buildings there that seem alive, with doors that open as if made of molten metal, according to the UFO researcher Grant Cameron. He says he has collected such accounts himself: "I've got a whole list of maybe 20 so far." He names no single source, and he treats the shared detail as a sign that these people may be describing a real place.
